name: tpl-existence-two-3-goal
task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses correctly capture the task requirements. The sequence 'be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal' is modeled as a chain of precedence leading to the hard goal Existence(at_goal). Existence(at_goal) and Precedence(door_open, at_goal) together force the door to be opened, and Precedence(has_key, door_open) forces the key to be held first. ExistenceTwo(has_key) ensures the key is held on at least two moves. Other existence clauses for has_key and door_open are correctly omitted as redundant.

texts: Be holding the key on at least two different moves
Be holding the key before opening the door
Open the door before reaching the goal
